comparison.objective: Unscrew a flashlight cap and pour its battery into a bin; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Thread-following cap removal, regrasping, and controlled tipping versus driver/wrench countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Cap and flashlight safely placed and battery in bin versus locked 90° opening retained through cycles.
comparison.reason: Threaded disassembly and battery removal do not test adjustment locking.
